reason: Neither conversation handled this well, but Conversation 1 at least twice labelled the problem 'overload / too full', confirmed to the homeowner that 'the duvet is probably the root cause' and told them to remove it, so the real fix is in their hands. It is badly undermined by the early misdirection (lock-delay, unbalanced-load), the unsupported claim that the internal catch may be snapped, and an unnecessary 'engineer to fit a new door catch assembly' recommendation. Conversation 2 was more efficient, safe and honest about uncertainty and correctly declined to name a part, but it completely failed to connect the bulging duvet squashed in the seal to the dE code and simply handed off to an engineer with no diagnosis, leaving the homeowner no better off.
